svg.text: 60 sts in the round × 34 rnds (≈30 × 12 cm). Cells drawn at gauge proportions (20 sts × 28 rnds = 10 cm),
so each stitch is wider than tall and the beans keep their oval shape in the fabric. Read every rnd right to left.
Rnd 1 at bottom; cast on 60, join in round.
Strand loosely; catch floats longer than 5 sts.
